request.description: Intakes stock into the warehouse location, increments StockBalance.quantity_on_hand and Product.quantity atomically, and updates PO received counts.
Atomically locks origin balance and decrements quantity_on_hand from origin stock location.
Atomically credits quantity_on_hand into destination stock location balance.
Compares physical count against system quantity and calculates variance automatically.
Applies variance directly to StockBalance and syncs parent Product catalog quantity.
